summary.summary: PARTIAL on 3^3. The crossing factor balances pi proportional to W for any fixed clocks and lengths, and an even record-following kernel does not bind a clump at first order. Rest-only and crossing-activity energies give P-Q = -117/3280 and 3893397/2555120 on the same three records. At weak field the activity clause has P/Q = 251/101 and 121/49 for the uniform two- and three-record laws, and the clocked-gas law stays above 1. The 8^3 simulation was not rebuilt. Which clause is the record's energy is open.
